# FLX-3704: --max-evaluations is outside the range the engine allows

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A fit runs the bundle once for each candidate it tries, and the engine's ceiling is 64 evaluations. --max-evaluations raises that ceiling for the one command, up to 4,096, when the bundle's calibration block declares no evaluations of its own; a bundle's own value is kept, may only lower the ceiling, and is read against the engine's 64 in every stage (FLX-3616). A value below 64 or above 4,096 is refused, and the message names the range. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3704
```
